title: Joshua Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on Joshua 19: the lots of Simeon, Zebulun, Issachar, Asher, Naphtali and Dan, and Joshua's own city.

questions.text: Where was the inheritance of Simeon located?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:1 says Simeon's inheritance was in the middle of the inheritance of the children of Judah.

answers.text: In the middle of Judah's inheritance
Next to the great sea in the north
In the hill country of Ephraim

questions.text: Which city in Simeon's list is given with the alternative name Sheba?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:2 lists Beersheba (or Sheba) as part of Simeon's inheritance.

questions.text: Why did Simeon receive its inheritance out of Judah's part?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:9 says the portion of the children of Judah was too much for them.

answers.text: Judah's portion was too much for them
Simeon asked to live near Judah

questions.text: For which tribe did the third lot come up?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:10 says the third lot came up for the children of Zebulun.

questions.text: Westward, Asher's border reached to which place?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:26 says Asher's border reached to Carmel westward, and to Shihorlibnath.

questions.text: Asher's border turned to Ramah and to which fortified city?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:29 says the border turned to Ramah, to the fortified city of Tyre.

questions.text: For which tribe did the sixth lot come out?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:32 says the sixth lot came out for the children of Naphtali.

questions.text: What did the children of Dan call Leshem after they took it?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:47 says they called Leshem Dan, after the name of Dan their forefather.

questions.text: Which city did Joshua receive as his inheritance?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:50 says they gave him the city he asked, Timnathserah in the hill country of Ephraim.

questions.text: Which priest, together with Joshua and the heads of the fathers' houses, distributed the inheritances?
questions.explanation: Joshua 19:51 says Eleazar the priest, Joshua the son of Nun and the heads of the fathers' houses distributed the land by lot in Shiloh.
